thread:
neha_onboard: Quick report from today's PoC: customer deploys use k8s projected secrets and we hit intermittent 401s after key rotation. CLI workflows ok, long-running apps not.

maria_sdk: can you paste what the sample and SDK are checking for env-wise?

neha_onboard: sample/node auth helper checks in order: REDWOOD_ORG_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY. SDK for python was only reading REDWOOD_KEY at import time and caching it.

ben_ops: so two problems: inconsistent precedence across our surface and import-time caching that ignores secret rotation.

neha_onboard: exactly. We rotated the secret by replacing the projected file and the process kept authenticating with the old one until restart. Logs show "using cached credential id: xyz" which confused ops and the customer.

maria_sdk: agreed we should standardize. Proposal: canonical env is REDWOOD_API_KEY (project-scoped), then REDWOOD_KEY for legacy fallthrough. Remove REDWOOD_ORG_KEY from priority unless explicitly set via config flag. Also, never stash whole secret at import-time; use a short TTL getter (default 5s) or file watcher for mounted secrets.

oliver_docs: I'll add a short migration note: "REDWOOD_API_KEY is canonical; REDWOOD_KEY deprecated—supported for a release cycle." Also doc the env for live rotation: REDWOOD_ENABLE_CRED_REFRESH=true and sample snippet for k8s projected secrets.

ben_ops: technical question: how do we detect mounted secret vs env var so we can choose file-watcher vs TTL?

maria_sdk: heuristic: if REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE or REDWOOD_KEY_FILE env exists, use fs.watch on that path; otherwise use env lookup with TTL. We'll also expose a CredentialWatcher API so apps can subscribe to rotation events.

neha_onboard: that sounds good. For compatibility, sample images should enable the refresh feature by default and log an obfuscated id on rotation so customers can see it happened.

infra-bot: NOTE: there is an existing opt-in: REDWOOD_ENABLE_CRED_REFRESH (default false in older images). New samples can flip default to true.

maria_sdk: plan: 1) implement dual-var lookup preferring REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) remove import-time caching, implement TTL and file-watcher strategy, 3) enable refresh by default in samples, 4) add unit + e2e test simulating projected secret replace, 5) update docs + release note about precedence and rotation.

ben_ops: I'll help build a small CI e2e that mounts a temp file, starts the sample, replaces the file, and asserts no 401s within 30s. Keep it fast with fake keys.

oliver_docs: I'll add a troubleshooting checklist: check env vars, check _FILE variants, check REDWOOD_ENABLE_CRED_REFRESH, restart guidance.

neha_onboard: thanks—this will prevent another support ticket. Please tag the PR and I9ll loop in the customer success contact.

infra-bot: Created issue CI-10111 "SDK/samples: normalize env var precedence and support live credential rotation" assigned to maria_sdk.
